extDescription.message: Closing a Safari window with the red button no longer loses its tabs. Reopen the window and they are back — per profile.

popupEmpty.message: Nothing remembered yet. Close a window with the red button and it will show up here.

popupTracking.message: Watching $WINDOWS$ window(s), $TABS$ tab(s) in this profile.

popupUndoHint.message: Opened in a window that already had a tab group? Undo puts everything back.

accessTitle.message: Safari is not giving access to your tabs yet

accessBody.message: Without it the extension cannot see a single URL and can remember nothing. Click the extension icon in the toolbar and choose “Always Allow on Every Website”, or set it in Safari → Settings → Extensions.

optionsProfileNote.message: These settings and this memory belong to the Safari profile you are in right now. Every profile keeps its own.

optionsFirstWindow.message: Bring every window back when Safari opens again

optionsEveryWindow.message: Also hand back the last closed window on every new empty window

optionsEveryWindowHint.message: Off by default: a new window you open yourself stays empty.

optionsMax.message: How many closed windows to remember

optionsSettle.message: Wait before deciding a window is empty (ms)

optionsSettleHint.message: This is the grace period that lets Safari fill a tab group first.

optionsClearConfirm.message: Erase every remembered window in this profile?

welcomeIntro.message: Safari does not hand an extension your tab URLs until you say so. Until you do, Venster-Memory can see nothing and remember nothing.

welcomeStep1.message: Click the Venster-Memory icon in the Safari toolbar.

welcomeStep3.message: Repeat this in every profile where you want it: extensions are off by default in a new profile, and each profile keeps its own memory.

welcomeDone.message: That is all. Close a window with the red button, open Safari again, and your tabs are back.

welcomeGroups.message: Tab groups are left alone — Safari already saves those itself. This is for the loose tabs at the top of the sidebar, the “<profile> — N tabs” entry.
